issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund shown as a Major governmental fund column on the governmental funds statements (pp4, 6, 8, 10)
issues.issue: Extractor rules list school nutrition among business-type funds; here the report itself presents it as a governmental fund and the Total Governmental Funds column (used for receipts/disbursements) includes it. Kept governmental, which is defensible, but it is a judgment call.
